title: Multi-omic data integration improves the resolution of the molecular etiology of autism in a mouse model.
abstract: RNA-seq, protein-centric 3D chromatin conformation (Hi-ChIP), and whole-genome DNA methylation sequencing of hippocampal tissue from Cntnap2 knockout ASD mouse model. Individual -omics identified 699 downregulated genes (neuronal enrichment), unique chromatin interactions, and 1220/1659 differentially methylated genes with neuronal function. Multi-omic integration refined signal to 43 ASD-linked genes (e.g., Zbtb18, Cttnbp2, Gabbr2) converging on one GO term: regulation of neuronal synaptic plasticity. Consistent with human ASD postmortem gene-expression studies.
